title: The cave paintings
text: In a cave above the river you find old paintings of animals and hands, and a place where someone once kept a fire.

options.text: Add your own hand to the wall.
options.note: {hero} left a hand on the cave wall, with {other} beside.

options.text: Gather the flint from the cave floor.
options.note: {hero} took flint from the cave floor.
